title: The symmetric Mahler conjecture and its equality cases
summary: We resolve the symmetric Mahler conjecture positively, including its equality classification. Every origin-symmetric convex body in ℝ n has volume product at least $`4^n/n!`$, with equality exactly for invertible linear images of Hanner polytopes.
